open_questions.question: Which qualifying State universities with accredited medicine programs had actually opened a Decreto 174 recognition/revalidation intake by 3 September 2026?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Legal eligibility does not prove that a university has created the required Coordinating Unit, published a procedure or accepts applications.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request dated written confirmation and the published procedure URL from each five-year advanced-accredited State university offering accredited medicine, and confirm with the Subsecretaría or Superintendencia.

open_questions.question: Has Mineduc exercised article 143’s discretionary direct power and published an updated covered-title list that includes any Ukrainian medical or academic qualification?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Such a list could create a direct Mineduc or agreement-based alternative to applying to a university.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Subsecretaría de Educación Superior for the article 143 list and agreements in force as of 3 September 2026, preferably through a transparency request.

open_questions.question: How are Universidad de Chile applications opened before 17 August 2026 handled after commencement of Decreto 174?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The regulation contains no express pending-file transition rule.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain a dated written answer from Universidad de Chile and Mineduc, identifying the regulation and tariff rules applied to pending files.

open_questions.question: To which Chilean academic degree, if any, will her “кандидат медичних наук” be assimilated, and what thesis or doctoral-program documentation will be required?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The Ukrainian qualification is not automatically equivalent to a Chilean doctorado, and the outcome affects university teaching applications.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Submit a pre-assessment inquiry with diploma, transcript, thesis abstract/full thesis and official Ukrainian qualification-framework evidence to an eligible university.

open_questions.question: What separate authority and pathway must recognize or certify her Ukrainian rheumatology specialty?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decreto 174 expressly leaves health specialties to separate rules, and general medical revalidation does not validate rheumatology.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Confirm the current specialty-certification route with the Superintendencia de Salud, CONACEM and the relevant medical faculty before relying on the general-degree result.

open_questions.question: Will the selected university allow initial filing and all preliminary review from Ukraine without RUT, ClaveÚnica or Chilean presence?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The regulation accepts a passport and prefers electronic processing, but individual portals and later examinations may impose practical requirements.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain written confirmation of account creation, payment from abroad, document delivery and examination format before applying.

open_questions.question: Does her son’s current Chilean nationality or immigration status create a family-reunification route?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Family reunification may assist later residence but does not change the credential-recognition rules established in this lane.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Verify the son’s status, her exact relationship evidence and current SERMIG eligibility in the separate immigration lane.

open_questions.question: Does a particular Chilean medical university require formal national recognition of her PhD or medical title for a purely teaching/research appointment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Credential recognition and institutional hiring are distinct, and requirements may vary by post and university.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the target university’s academic-affairs and human-resources units for the written appointment rule applicable to foreign academics who will not provide clinical care.

open_questions.question: Is Ecuador’s mutual-recognition treaty accepting new Mineduc applications after its omission from the January 2026 service page?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It affects the completeness of the current treaty-country map, although it does not affect this Ukrainian applicant directly.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request a dated status confirmation and any suspension instrument from Mineduc and MINREL.

unknowns_declared: No dated post-17-August-2026 official intake procedure was located for an eligible State university other than Universidad de Chile.
No Mineduc article 143 updated title list or agreement covering Ukrainian qualifications was located.
Decreto 174 contains no express rule for applications pending before commencement, and no separate official transition instruction was located.
No later Chile–Ukraine degree-recognition treaty was found; the conclusion rests on the bilateral agreement’s prospective wording and Ukraine’s absence from current official route lists.
The Chilean degree to which “кандидат медичних наук” would be assimilated cannot be determined without an individual academic assessment.
No nationwide conversion or recognition procedure for the academic rank “доцент” was identified.
